name: Microgrid disturbance-recorder trigger interface
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Maps the selected microgrid event to the assigned disturbance recording request.
description: Maps the selected microgrid event to the assigned disturbance recording request. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Defined operating disturbance” at the input and “Recorder trigger” at the output. The recorded channels and trigger scope must be specified.
